item.title: Show HN: A multiplayer play-money terminal casino for downtime
item.summary: Hi HN! I created Anteroom, a hobby project allowing you to play casino (and non-casino) games with your friends in your terminal. The project is complete with hooks for Claude & Codex which allow in-app alerts as well as a global leaderboard. Happy to take the past two weeks to craft this and there is definitely room to add more games in the future. Cheers!
